# nomatron_application (Resource)

Nomatron application resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_application" "example" {
  org_name     = "platform"
  name         = "Payments"
  slug         = "payments"
  cluster_id   = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
  repo_url     = "https://github.com/nomatron/payments"
  git_provider = "github"
  ref          = "main"
  auto_plan    = true
  auto_apply   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Nomad cluster ID backing the application.
- `name` (String) Application display name.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.
- `repo_url` (String) Source repository URL.

### Optional

- `auto_apply` (Boolean) Whether Nomatron automatically applies approved changes for this application.
- `auto_plan` (Boolean) Whether Nomatron automatically plans changes for this application.
- `description` (String) Application description.
- `git_provider` (String) Git provider for the repository, such as `github`.
- `ref` (String) Git ref to track. Defaults to `main` when omitted.
- `slug` (String) Stable application slug. If omitted, the server generates one.
- `vcs_github_id` (String) Optional GitHub App integration ID for repository sync.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the application was created.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the application was last updated.
- `updated_by` (String) Actor ID that last updated the application, when available.
